structure: Part 10 mined all 14 trace zips its read names, from three spec files in the tests repo's animals project: features/transit-means-scope.spec.ts (1: the transit-countries page is routed only for rail or road; changing the means wipes saved countries [c1ede, worked here as 'scope']), pages/arrival-details.spec.ts (7: renders the page controls [7cfe8]; leaves the arrival details unanswered on load [a7777]; accepts valid arrival details [230ae]; saves a draft and moves on when submitted empty [2893e]; restricts the date picker to one week back and six months ahead [28173]; rejects a typed arrival date outside the allowed window [201d0]; does not save an arrival date outside the allowed window [327f9]) and pages/transited-countries.spec.ts (6: renders the country search and an empty list [09be0]; accepts and persists multiple transited countries [313f8]; removes a country from the list, leaving the others [7fdf3]; transit countries are optional, first attempt timed out [263c1] and retry 1 passed [263c1-retry1]; shows an error summary when Add country is pressed with no country chosen [d89f3]). The three spec files were read in full to know what each test asserts. The bundled trace viewer refuses every zip (TraceVersionError: recorded by a newer Playwright), confirmed again on this run, so each zip was unzipped into this part's work folder and read directly: N-trace.trace (actions and frame-snapshot DOM rendered back to HTML), N-trace.network (the browser's requests) and test.trace (steps and errors). Refs name the trace by its folder hash fragment, then the call id. The run was recorded on 7 October 2026, which fixes the dates seen. Pages in this slice, in the order a user meets them: (1) the notification overview's section '3. Transport and arrival', mined only for the 'Arrival details' and conditional 'Transit countries' task rows and their status tags; (2) Arrival details at /notifications/{ref}/port-of-entry (caption Transport and arrival): arrival date at port of entry (MOJ date picker, window one week back to six months ahead), port of entry (autocomplete over 78 GB ports), means of transport (Airplane, Railway, Road Vehicle, Vessel), transport identification and transport document reference, then Save and continue, Save and return to overview and Cancel and return to overview; its states are blank on load, saved and re-shown, saved empty as a draft, and the out-of-window error (HTTP 400, nothing saved); (3) the transit countries page at /notifications/{ref}/transit-countries (caption Movement, h1 Which countries will the consignment travel through?): an autocomplete country field over 31 European countries, an Add country button, the empty-list text or a table of added countries with Remove buttons, a live status announcement, the 'Enter a country to add' error, and the same button group. What is conditional: the transit countries page and its hub row appear only when the saved means is road (rail per the test title only; no trace picks Railway); Airplane, Vessel and a blank means go straight to Transporter details; changing the means away from road wipes the saved countries. Transporter details is reached here only as the landing page after a save and belongs to another part. The optional-countries test's first attempt never reached this slice's pages: it timed out in beforeEach when the commodities post returned HTTP 500. Network logs show only browser-to-frontend traffic: the port and country lists arrive in the page HTML.
